A bill for an act relating to pipelines; prohibiting the issuance of a route permit for certain carbon dioxide pipelines; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivisions 1, 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Definitions.
(a) For the purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.
(b) "Carbon dioxide pipeline" means a pipeline located in Minnesota that transports carbon dioxide in a liquid, gaseous, or supercritical state.
(c) "Commission" means the Public Utilities Commission.

[+(d) "Public waters" has the meaning given in section 103G.005, subdivision 15. +]

[-(d)-][+ (e)+] "Supercritical" means a physical state in which a substance is more dense than a gas but less dense than a liquid.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Routing permit required[+; prohibitions+].
(a) A person is prohibited from constructing or operating a carbon dioxide pipeline without a route permit issued by the commission under this chapter.
(b) A person seeking to construct or operate a carbon dioxide pipeline is prohibited from applying to the commission for a conditional exclusion or partial exemption from pipeline route selection procedures under Minnesota Rules, chapter 7852.

[+(c) The commission is prohibited from issuing a permit to construct a carbon dioxide pipeline that: +]

[+(1) exceeds 1,000 feet in length in Minnesota; or +]

[+(2) travels over, under, or through public waters. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to pipelines; prohibiting the issuance of a route permit for certain carbon dioxide pipelines; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivisions 1, 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Definitions.
(a) For the purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.
(b) "Carbon dioxide pipeline" means a pipeline located in Minnesota that transports carbon dioxide in a liquid, gaseous, or supercritical state.
(c) "Commission" means the Public Utilities Commission.

(d) "Public waters" has the meaning given in section 103G.005, subdivision 15.

(e) "Supercritical" means a physical state in which a substance is more dense than a gas but less dense than a liquid.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216G.025, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Routing permit required; prohibitions.
(a) A person is prohibited from constructing or operating a carbon dioxide pipeline without a route permit issued by the commission under this chapter.
(b) A person seeking to construct or operate a carbon dioxide pipeline is prohibited from applying to the commission for a conditional exclusion or partial exemption from pipeline route selection procedures under Minnesota Rules, chapter 7852.

(c) The commission is prohibited from issuing a permit to construct a carbon dioxide pipeline that:

(1) exceeds 1,000 feet in length in Minnesota; or

(2) travels over, under, or through public waters.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
